title: Brevard County Historic Flooding Event (48 hr)

QPE_FFGMAX.label: QPE as % of FFG, max of 1/3/6 h

lines: Best placement of the ≥ 8″ area: RRFS (ETS 0.04).
Closest on the peak: RRFS, 10.88″ vs 25.12″ observed at its resolution (43%).
Far too dry overall (under half the observed rain volume): REFS LPMM 37%, ECMWF IFS 38%, ECMWF ENS mean 44%, REFS AVRG 47%, HRRR 48%.
Earliest signal: ECMWF ENS max reached half the observed peak 72 h before the window started.
summary.method: Score = mean of placement (ETS at the event threshold ÷ 0.5, capped at 1), peak (e^-|ln ratio| of forecast to observed near-max at the model's resolution) and volume (e^-|ln bias|), each from the model's shortest-lead run.
